name: accessibility-review
title_zh: 给课程设计做 WCAG 无障碍与 UDL 双轨体检
tagline_zh: 课件上线前，一次跑完「必须修」的无障碍违规和「建议改」的通用学习设计。不只看红绿灯，还告诉你哪条路更宽。
tagline_en: One pass over your course design: 'Must Fix' WCAG violations plus 'Should Improve' UDL nudges. Not just red.
desc_en: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance audit plus Universal Design for Learning (UDL 3.0) enhancement review for course designs. Two-tier output: "Must Fix" for accessibility violations and "Should Improve" for UDL recommendations. Works standalone or reads from the idstack project manifest. (idstack)
why_zh: 双轨输出：合规是底线，UDL 是加分项。能独立跑，也能读 idstack 项目清单，自动对齐上下文。
why_en: Two-tier output: compliance as floor, UDL as ceiling. Runs standalone or reads the idstack manifest—no redundant setup.
limit_zh: 只审课程设计类文档，不碰代码或交互原型。WCAG 仅覆盖 2.1 AA 级别，AAA 或 2.2 新规不管。
limit_en: Course-design docs only; no code or prototypes. WCAG 2.1 AA only—no AAA or 2.2. UDL output is text report, not patches. Needs explicit input path.
